en.note: Starting a session. "Login provider", the name of the admin feature, stays.
The label of the action that creates an account.

ja.note: A narrow screen where the bottom tab bar is the navigation ("phone" in en).

avoid: アカウントを作[らりるれろっ]
ja.note: The label and wording of the action that creates an account.
Matches the retry button もう一度試す (web-client G16, G18).

zh-CN.note: How the copy addresses the user: the plain 你, as mainland Chinese apps do (web-client G19).
A post. Not the names of other services' posts.
Starting a session. 登陆 is a common misspelling.
Ending a session. 注销 is not used for it either: it means closing an account.
Blocking an account or a domain.
A narrow screen where the bottom tab bar is the navigation ("phone" in en).

zh-TW.note: How the copy addresses the user: the plain 你, as Taiwanese apps with a casual tone do (web-client G19).
A post. Not the names of other services' posts; 推文 is also a reply on PTT.
An account. One spelling everywhere, as Taiwan writes it.
Ending a session. 註銷 is not used for it either.
Following an account, and a follower (追蹤者), as Taiwan says it.
Muting an account or a word.
Blocking an account or a domain.
Reporting an account or a post to the moderators.
A narrow screen where the bottom tab bar is the navigation ("phone" in en).
A person who uses the service. Taiwan's word, not the mainland's. 用戶端 (a client app) stays.
A message or a piece of information (資訊 for information in general).

es.note: How the copy addresses the user: tú, as neutral Spanish apps do in Spain and Latin America; never usted, vosotros or voseo (web-client G19).
A post (publicar for the action). Not the names of other services' posts.
A boost: impulsar for the action, impulso for the thing.
A favourite: marcar como favorito, quitar de favoritos.
A bookmark: guardar en marcadores.
Starting a session. "Login provider", the name of the admin feature, is translated as proveedor de inicio de sesión.
Ending a session.
Following an account (seguir a {handle}) and a follower.
Muting an account or a word.
Reporting an account or a post to the moderators. Reportar is an anglicism in this sense.
A content warning (CW).
The settings of an account or an instance.
A narrow screen where the bottom tab bar is the navigation ("phone" in en); móvil alone also reads well everywhere.
A computer: each word is regional.
An email, or correo for short.
A link.
A video, written without the accent as most of the Spanish-speaking world does.
A hashtag.
A supporter who pays for the instance; a supporter plan is a plan de apoyo.
The costs of running the instance (costo is understood everywhere).
Banning an account: the moderation action that removes it from the server.

pt-BR.note: How the copy addresses the user: você, as Brazilian apps do; never tu, vós or their possessives (teu, vosso), which read as European Portuguese (web-client G19).
A post (publicar for the action). Not the names of other services' posts.
A boost: impulsionar for the action, impulso for the thing.
A favourite: favoritar, remover dos favoritos.
A bookmark: salvar a publicação, the list of itens salvos ("Favoritos" is taken by favourites).
Starting a session: entrar for the action (Entrar, entrar na conta). Login as a noun reads well in Brazil (fazer login, login desativado, provedor de login); logar does not.
Ending a session (sair, sair da conta).
Following an account (seguir {handle}) and a follower.
Muting an account or a word.
Reporting an account or a post to the moderators. Reportar is an anglicism in this sense.
A content warning (CW).
Banning an account: the moderation action that removes it from the server.
A role of an account (funções for the list); the word is feminine.
A supporter who pays for the instance; a supporter plan is a plano de apoio.
The settings of an account or an instance. Definições is European Portuguese.
A user. Utilizador is European Portuguese.
A screen. Ecrã is European Portuguese.
A file. Ficheiro is European Portuguese.
A password. Palavra-passe is European Portuguese.
A narrow screen where the bottom tab bar is the navigation ("phone" in en); dispositivo móvel also reads well.
Brazilian spelling: registrar, registro, contato, fato, atual, recepção, ótimo; never the European forms.
The costs of running the instance.
A video, written with the accent as Brazilian Portuguese does.
